findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "text" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pseudonymize_pii, text_summarize, text_spellcheck, markdown_to_html, html_to_text, check_subtitle_delivery, pdf_redact, pdf_redaction_check, check_text_for_secrets, check_text_sources · Private data: redact_pii, pseudonymize_pii, diff_text, markdown_to_html, html_to_text, check_subtitle_delivery, pdf_redact, check_text_for_secrets · Public sink: redact_pii, pseudonymize_pii, text_frequency, html_to_text · Destructive: text_extract, diff_text.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pseudonymize_pii, text_summarize, text_spellcheck, markdown_to_html, html_to_text, check_subtitle_delivery, pdf_redact, pdf_redaction_check, check_text_for_secrets, check_text_sources · Private data: redact_pii, pseudonymize_pii, diff_text, markdown_to_html, html_to_text, check_subtitle_delivery, pdf_redact, check_text_for_secrets · Public sink: redact_pii, pseudonymize_pii, text_frequency, html_to_text · Destructive: text_extract, diff_text

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
